Buy a Mexican Green Card on Telegram

The Mexican green card is issued by the INM. Every real one carries marks from that office and a seller who cannot point to them is guessing. This page is a checklist for that conversation.

Issuing authority
the INM
Observed price band

Typical delivery

Local name
tarjeta de residente permanente
Document type
A green card is the United States permanent resident card. Outside the United States the same job is done by a permanent residence card, and sellers use the American term loosely for every country.

buy mexican green card on telegram – the short version

Nothing about Telegram makes a Mexican green card more likely to be fake. It is a shop window with no returns policy, which is why the checks matter more here than they would at a counter.

Everything here assumes the seller is a stranger and the money is not reversible. That is the normal condition on Telegram and it is why the process later on is staged rather than a single transfer.

Buy a Green Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

Delivery is where most Mexican green card deals go quiet. Insist on a tracking number inside forty eight hours and treat a seller who only offers a photo of an envelope as unproven.

Do not send the balance against a promise of a tracking number. Send it against the number itself, checked on the carrier site rather than on a screenshot.

Who actually issues a Green Card

Every feature on a Mexican green card exists because the INM put it there: substrate, print method, UV ink, number format. Strip those out and what is left is a picture of a card.

Finally, remember the office never contacts you. Any message claiming to be from the INM confirming your purchase is a second party, usually the seller, and worth exactly as much as their word.

Replica or registered original

Replica and registered original are used interchangeably in adverts and they are not the same purchase. A replica is a print. It copies the layout and fails on UV, on substrate and on the number.

The failure modes are different too. A print fails the first UV torch. Stock fails the number. A registered original fails only if the entry has lapsed or the details do not match it.

What a fair price looks like

Prices move with the document own difficulty. A card with a chip and a UV layer costs more to produce than a laminate print and the advert should reflect that.

Replacement terms are the other hidden line. A seller who replaces a failed parcel prices higher and is usually worth the premium, but only after a track record long enough to make the promise mean something.

The buying process, step by step

Follow these in sequence and stop at the first one that fails.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the INM.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the INM uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 4800–15500 MXN band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the checks that separate a real Mexican green card from a good print. All of them are cheap to run and two are local to Mexico.

  • Check the licence for the state secretariat named in the header and the state specific number format.
  • Confirm the passport eagle printing and the machine-readable zone check digits.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the INM. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

Red flags specific to Mexico, plus the generic tells that apply anywhere.

  • A licence whose header names a state that does not issue that format.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What does a green card cost on Telegram?

Between 350 and 1600 US dollars. The top of the band is where a number that resolves at the immigration office should sit.

Is a green card the same as a residence permit?

In the United States yes, in practice. Elsewhere the green card is the permanent tier and the residence permit is the fixed term tier below it.

Can the number be checked?

Only against the immigration register. Ask the seller which register the number sits in and expect a specific answer.

Why are green cards so expensive?

Because the number carries the most weight of any document here and the register check is the hardest to fake.

What is the usual fake?

A high quality print of a real card with the number left intact and the personal details changed.
